title: Second time visiting Barcelona and this was honestly one of the highlights of the trip
text: The tapas were great, the wine spots felt really local, and the guide made the whole evening super easy and fun without feeling touristy. We ended up discovering places we would’ve never found on our own. Definitely a really good way to spend a night in the city.

title: Bcn tapas tour
text: Our time in Barcelona was made even more special thanks to this private tapas tour! Antonione, our guide, was fantastic.
author: JesCR

title: We will definitely do this again
text: Wow! This private tapas tour in Barcelona was one of the highlights of our trip. Antonione, our guide, had so much knowledge about the local cuisine and took us to some amazing, off-the-beaten-path tapas bars. The food was incredible, and the experience felt so personal. We will definitely do this again!
author: kimberlyhT664JG

title: TAPAS BARCELONA
text: We had such a great time on this private tapas tour in Barcelona! Jorge, our guide, was amazing—he knew all the best local spots and made sure we had an authentic experience.
